clause_path: Section 23.1 -- type phasing (vc-2.0, c2pa-manifest, rfc3161-snapshot, zktls)

obligations.label: of the four attestation types, rfc3161-snapshot, vc-2.0 and c2pa-manifest are verifiable at evaluation time, while zktls attestations are verified external to the evaluator
vc-2.0 attestations are verified as Verifiable Credentials 2.0 proofs
rfc3161-snapshot attestations are checked as RFC 3161 timestamp snapshots
c2pa-manifest attestations are checked structurally as C2PA manifests
zktls attestations must not be presented as confirmed by the evaluator; their verdict is external
